text:
jordan: CI failing on master: DAST job aborts with 'keystore decrypt failed' when scanner tries to fetch creds. Happening on nightly runs since rotation. Do we grant scanner service account decrypt rights or change flow to ephemeral grant? cc @sarah for oncall.

ci-bot: dast-runner failed — exit code 1. logs: `keystore: decrypt error: permission denied (403)`

lee: don't give long-lived decrypt rights; propose ephemeral grant via onboarding workflow + audit log. We added similar for package-signer last year.

maria: Agree. If we must unblock immediate deploys, we can add a temporary grant TTL 1h and require SSO approval. Also want to surface audit entries in keystore logs: fields to confirm: principal, resource, request_id.

jordan: here's the failing snippet from CI logs:
```
2026-02-10T04:12:33Z level=error component=dast-runner msg="keystore decrypt failed" err="permission denied"
request_id=abc123 trace_id=tr-9876
```

sarah: oncall here — starting triage. Need to know who owns the DAST config and who to ping for PR. Is this blocking release? what's timeline? :eyes: 

jordan: Not blocking canary but blocks nightly regression. Owning team = web-qa. PR: https://git.redwood/example/web-qa/pulls/432

lee: IAM snippet we can use for ephemeral grant:
```
{ "principal": "service:web-dast", "action": "kms:Decrypt", "conditions": {"ttl":"1h", "workflow":"ephemeral-grant"} }
```

maria: Also propose policy change: if keystore-decrypt fails during premerge CI, mark it non-blocking and open a ticket + alert oncall to avoid false blockers.

sarah: Sounds good. I'll create a security ticket and assign to security-scan-team. SLA: 24h triage for CI-blocking DAST failures.

jordan: Thanks — opened PR with fix: https://git.redwood/example/web-qa/pulls/433. Will flip on temporary grant after sec review.

sec-bot: Audit hook enabled on keystore for scanner grants — events will forward to /alerts/security-scans. summary: 1 hook created.

lee: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate with infra to add TTL and will post steps in infra-runbook.

maria: Also can we add SAST correlation tag so triage links SAST+DAST findings? include `scan_trace_id` in payloads.

sarah: Yep, add `scan_trace_id` in payloads. I'll update the playbook. Assigning owner: jordan, lee.

jordan: Acknowledged. timeline: temp grant today, infra change next week. Thanks :pray:
